entries.what: The static methods YouTubeTranscriptApi.get_transcript, get_transcripts and list_transcripts were removed in v1.2.0, so calling one raises AttributeError.

source.quote: Removed the deprecated methods get_transcript , get_transcripts and list_transcripts

lookFor: A call of get_transcript, get_transcripts or list_transcripts on the YouTubeTranscriptApi class
requires: fetch() returns objects with attributes, so p["text"] becomes p.text unless the result goes through to_raw_data(). This shape change is a reading of the v1.0.0 notes.
